name: What information do I need before I ask for a casing installation estimate?

mainEntity.name: What information do I need before I ask for a casing installation estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: You’ll usually need the door opening dimensions, trim style preference, and whether you want paint-grade or stain-grade material. It also helps to know if the existing casing should be matched, replaced everywhere in the room, or installed after a new door is set.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have the door size, trim style, and finish preference ready. Tell the installer whether you need matching trim, full replacement, or casing installed after a new door.
